title: Creativity shared article structure
scope: All 31 reader-facing entries in See the Problem Differently and Find New Possibilities: 30 patterns and the Five Alternative Frames practice. The shared explanatory outline applies to both entity types.
opening: An unheaded recognizable situation before Core idea.
practice_policy: Existing executable sources, practice prompts, identities, summaries, memberships and attribution are retained. Practices follow the article as separate sections.
visual_policy: Use an explanatory illustration when a concrete relationship, comparison, sequence, or change in possibilities is easier to see. Place it beside the worked example. Use the approved light editorial style and supply a separately composed phone version, alternative text and a caption.

visual.rationale: The routes vary in access, cost, and tradeoffs. The comparisons are clearer in text; Abstraction Laddering supplies the related branching mechanism.
The paired benefits differ across examples; a general two-to-three-option diagram would conceal the actual design work.

visual.alt_text: The proposed chain links more meetings to better communication to fewer mistakes. Under each arrow is a question: are decisions recorded, and which mistakes involve missing information?
visual.caption: The arrows are assumptions to examine. Recording decisions or clarifying ownership may matter more than adding meetings; the chain alone cannot settle that.
visual.rationale: Separate questions attached to each causal link distinguish the intended outcome from the proposed mechanism.
The contrast is between an intervention named in a request and the result sought. The paired sentences expose that distinction.
The varied professional interpretations and their checks are directly legible in the examples.

visual.alt_text: A timeline places changing expectations and urgent requests before a missed deadline. After it, anticipated criticism may delay the next warning. The expectation is marked as a hypothesis.
visual.caption: Widen the time window around the missed deadline. Sequence is not proof of cause: check both the earlier demands and the person’s account of the anticipated response.
visual.rationale: The timeline separates the visible episode from nearby events and from an inferred expectation.

visual.alt_text: The concern that meetings run too long leads to two moves. Exploration inspects which agenda item expands; breaking the frame asks which decisions need a live meeting at all.
visual.caption: Exploring keeps the meeting as the setting and investigates variation. Breaking questions whether the decisions need to be synchronous. Either move may be useful.
visual.rationale: A paired comparison holds the concern constant while distinguishing a closer investigation from a changed premise.
The examples generate possible explanations rather than an established causal graph. Text keeps those qualifications attached to each hypothesis.

visual.alt_text: The same shipping crate is drawn as a storage container and as a possible raised display surface. The new use relies on its shape and stiffness and still requires a stability check.
visual.caption: Look beyond the label “storage.” A crate may provide a raised surface, but its strength and stability need checking before it becomes part of a stall.
visual.rationale: The same concrete object in two uses shows how a functional label can hide useful properties.
The useful change is the wording of the provisional statement, already visible in three comparisons.

visual.alt_text: Vendor A, Vendor B, and an internal dashboard share the assumption of preserving a report. Other options question whether to simplify, partly automate, or retire the report.
visual.caption: The first group varies the implementation while retaining the report. The second changes the underlying account of what work is needed. Relevance still matters more than novelty.
visual.rationale: Grouping choices by their shared premise makes structural diversity visible.
The forms are deliberately overlapping, tentative routing aids. A diagram could imply rigid categories.
Observation, feeling, and interpretation need the speaker’s exact language and qualifications. The text avoids implying an emotion has one underlying cause.
The four framings hold one incident constant and show the effect of pronouns and responsibility directly in words.
The four lenses are explained through a concrete hiring case; a generic boundary illustration would repeat the metaphor without adding evidence.

visual.alt_text: A release is connected to developers implementing, a product owner changing scope, reviewers approving, support handling defects, and customers waiting. The labels describe roles rather than assign blame.
visual.caption: Map what each group does or experiences before deciding where the delay originates. A role map suggests people to consult; it does not establish the cause.
visual.rationale: A spatial map restores omitted roles and makes the difference between responsibility and causal blame visible.

visual.alt_text: One concern, always being behind, branches into work arriving faster than it can finish and one request type blocking the rest. Each frame points to a different observation.
visual.caption: Both frames retain the backlog concern. One asks for incoming and completed work; the other asks where work waits. These checks can refine either interpretation.
visual.rationale: The branches pair each interpretation with its distinct check, showing why a wording change alone is insufficient.
The restrictive phrase and broader question are already explicit in each example. Keeping the confirmed limits visible matters more than a generic expansion graphic.
The approval-process example explains the change directly; the neighboring goal tree and alternative-route figures provide the useful spatial views.
The scan selects a relevant question rather than following every lens. Another process graphic could make the quick review appear compulsory.

visual.alt_text: A promotion branches into income, responsibility, and recognition. Each branch points to a different possible purpose: financial security, consequential work, and feeling valued.
visual.caption: Keep the branches distinct. A route that increases income may not provide responsibility or recognition; the person decides which purposes fit their experience.
visual.rationale: The tree preserves multiple legitimate purposes instead of collapsing the goal into a single inferred motive.
The paired predictions and checks are already explicit; Rapid Reframe illustrates the frame-to-observation relationship.
The distinction depends on the wording and evidential status of each claim; the paired text examples are the clearest explanation.

visual.alt_text: The room-booking website leads to the purpose of reliable access to suitable rooms. That purpose also leads to clearer descriptions, standing allocations, and drop-in space.
visual.caption: Ask what booking makes possible, then return through other ways to provide suitable space. The alternatives still need to meet the same requirements.
visual.rationale: The branches make the move from one implementation to a purpose and back through alternative implementations visible.

visual.alt_text: Three dimensions each offer two choices: setting, encounter, and contribution. Walking route, audio excerpts, and remembered places combine into a listening trail; the kitchen-table combination becomes a conversation pack.
visual.caption: Choose one alternative from each dimension, then describe and check the combination. The listening trail and conversation pack differ in their underlying arrangement.
visual.rationale: Aligned alternatives and complete combinations make recombination concrete without pretending to enumerate every possible design.

visual.alt_text: Six thinking jobs connect the courtyard concern to a trial: understand use, describe success, frame a question, generate options, develop a proposal, and align resources. A dashed return from the storage question reopens development.
visual.caption: The courtyard proposal moves through six different thinking jobs. If storage is unavailable, return to development instead of treating the plan as settled.
visual.rationale: The figure distinguishes thinking jobs and makes the return from a resource discovery to solution development explicit.

visual.alt_text: Two simplified event entrance plans compare one host dividing attention between a visitor, a list, and a waiting person with two roles: initial contact and booking lookup. A separate map and queue marker are added in the second scene.
visual.caption: The second scene redistributes attention and clarifies waiting. Acting it out can expose new exceptions; the arrangement has not yet been validated with real visitors.
visual.rationale: A concrete plan comparison makes attention, roles, and physical arrangement visible in the same welcome-desk case.

visual.alt_text: A wordless drawing places one person between two blocks. A revised drawing shows people within both blocks and several possible connections. Tentative interpretations sit outside the drawings.
visual.caption: Changing scale and relationships can open a question about connecting work. The viewer’s interpretation remains tentative, and the artist can correct or reject it.
visual.rationale: The paired drawings demonstrate the change of representation while keeping interpretations outside the wordless image.
The two worked cases explain different framing moves; a generic branching image would add little beyond the more specific figures in the specialist articles.
The useful change is the size of a concrete commitment. The sentence and photographic examples communicate it directly.

visual.alt_text: The same observation, few members speaking, is viewed through five possible frames: turn-taking, the opening question, discussion climate, the purpose of the gathering, and participation conditions. Each points to a different inquiry.
visual.caption: Keep the observation constant while changing the account. These five frames suggest different questions; they are hypotheses to examine, and several may overlap.
visual.rationale: The comparison demonstrates five structurally different interpretations and the different inquiry each opens.

coverage_rule: Audit the complete set of collection items rather than filtering by pattern type. Every entry must have a substantive readable explanation before any executable practice.
